
  Minor precision point if it comes up: Ryan's "the ID doesn't exist until the
  XML103 API call" isn't quite right — submissionGuid is minted at the start of
  submission, before the payload is built. Doesn't change his conclusion for the
  other docs, but it's why the TDR case works.
